title: Output multiset cardinality
statement: Let an almost-wise input have independence order $k$ and output dimension $n$, with $1\le k\le n$. Let its bias be the positive rational number whose numerator is $a$ and denominator is $b$, where $2a\le b$. If $r$ is the number of random bits specified by this input, then its output multiset has cardinality $2^r$.
hypotheses_covered: Independence order is at most the output dimension: $k\le n$
Twice the bias numerator is at most its denominator: $2a\le b$
